title: Eating by the stages of a training plan
description: Keep the targets that were chosen and the history of how they changed. See when and why the settings changed.

blocks.text: A user likes it when the app revises the targets as the diary goes on. But how understandable an automatic change is and whether it suits the person are different questions.

quote.text: This app is truly designed for real life. The adaptive calorie and macro adjustments based on your metabolism just makes sense. Tracking your macros/calories alongside your daily weight makes so much more sense than tracking movement or activity.

blocks.text: Show the history of the chosen targets

Keep the goal, the values in force and every change with its date and its grounds. Show what the app suggests separately from the parameters the user has accepted or agreed with a specialist. Keep it possible to go back to the underlying entries.
Test the controls first, the calculation second

It is worth finding out whether the person understands why the settings changed and what they can do about them. This is not a test of the algorithm’s physiological accuracy and not grounds for promising values that suit everyone.
